description: Sticky/floating action bar for long forms. Groups start content and a status slot on the left with primary, secondary, and danger action slots on the right, inside a max-width-centered, responsive row. Position can be Static, StickyTop, FloatingBottom, or FloatingBottomFromMd (static in flow below the 768px md boundary, floating at the viewport bottom from md up — the responsive mode owns its media query inside the scoped stylesheet and collapses --tm-form-action-bar-reserve-block-size to zero below the same boundary, so the reserve never lingers as dead space on mobile). ShowOnScroll arms a functional passive scroll listener that reveals the bar once the page scrolls past a threshold.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: Placement mode: Static (normal flow), StickyTop, FloatingBottom, or FloatingBottomFromMd (responsive: static below 768px, floating at the viewport bottom from 768px up; the host reserve token --tm-form-action-bar-reserve-block-size resolves to zero below the same boundary).

parameters.name: ShowOnScroll
parameters.description: When true, the bar starts hidden and a passive scroll listener reveals it once the page has been scrolled past a threshold (and hides it again near the top). Functional, not a reserved no-op hook.

parameters.name: PrimaryActions
parameters.description: Primary (e.g. Save) action buttons, rendered right-most.

parameters.name: DangerActions
parameters.description: Destructive (e.g. Delete) action buttons, rendered left-most within the action cluster.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Save/validation status content shown next to the start content (e.g. "Saved").

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Left/start content, typically a title or breadcrumb.

parameters.name: LiveMessage
parameters.description: Optional polite aria-live status text announced to assistive technology.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the root element.

examples.title: Floating-bottom bar that reveals on scroll
Responsive bar: static below md, floating from md up
examples.code:
<TmFormActionBar Position="FormActionBarPosition.FloatingBottomFromMd" AriaLabel="Page actions">
    <SecondaryActions>
        <TmButton Variant="ButtonVariant.Secondary" OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</TmButton>
    </SecondaryActions>
    <PrimaryActions>
        <TmButton Variant="ButtonVariant.Primary" OnClick="Save">Save</TmButton>
    </PrimaryActions>
</TmFormActionBar>
@* Leave room under the floating bar; the token reads 0 below md automatically:
   .my-form-page { padding-block-end: var(--tm-form-action-bar-reserve-block-size); } *@
